name: preserve-behaviours
title: The behaviours a fix must not regress: the second field Self-Harness requires of a failure record
description: Self-Harness requires a failure record to carry the passing behaviours a proposal must not regress, and the record has carried nothing of the kind. Declare which suites verify each component, and let the record carry the ones its evidence points at - or none, when the evidence points nowhere
